text: Psalm 128 A Song of Ascents. Blessed is everyone who fears the Lord, who walks in His ways.
For you shall eat the fruit of the labor of your hands; you will be happy, and it shall be well with you.
Your wife shall be as a fruitful vine in your house, your children like olive shoots around your table.
Behold, this man shall be blessed who fears the Lord.
The Lord shall bless you from Zion, and may you see the welfare of Jerusalem all the days of your life.
Indeed, may you see your children’s children. Peace upon Israel!
